library: aspire_station skill library (code-as-policy, station = cable routing around pegs)

skills.name: topological_side_routing
skills.failure_signature: final sides_now != post_sides although tool is at target; or |W| < pi/2 for a post
skills.when_to_apply: planning the tool path at t=0 for any situation
skills.repair_strategy: The cable cannot pass through or over the pegs, so each peg's winding is fixed by the homotopy class of the tool path (W depends only on endpoints + class). Pass every peg on the side opposite to its required sign relative to the anchor->target direction (side +1 = peg on the left of travel). Verified offline on 200/200 snapshots (min |W| 1.92 rad) and in 55/55 real episodes.
skills.code_sketch: left = perp(normalize(target - anchor)); waypoints = [tool0] + [c_j - side_j * left * 0.07 for posts sorted along anchor->target] + [target]

skills.name: taut_path_min_wrap
skills.failure_signature: load climbs to 9-10 N while the cable is wrapped tightly around pegs and dragged around them (observation 901, 902, 905, 907, 909); path with dips/U-turns between pegs
skills.when_to_apply: after the waypoint path is built
skills.repair_strategy: String-pull the waypoint path inside its homotopy class with discs of radius 0.065 m around the peg centres: straight segments + arcs, no unnecessary wrap. Median path length fell 0.98 -> 0.72 m and total turning 7.9 -> 1.35 rad on the snapshots; max real load 5.2-5.6 N.
skills.code_sketch: for it: Q[1:-1] = (P[:-2]+P[2:])/2; P = push_out(Q, posts, 0.065)  # coarse (3 cm) then fine (1 cm)

skills.name: load_governed_speed
skills.failure_signature: load rises with drag speed ('fights back when you hurry'); overload at fixed 0.12 m/s reading (~0.15 m/s actual)
skills.repair_strategy: Advance an internal reference along the path at v(load): vmax 0.10 m/s below 4 N, linear to 0 at 7 N, back off 4 mm/step above 8.5 N. The load reading responds within one or two control periods, so this closed-loop rule regulates wrapped-cable drag to ~5 N.
skills.code_sketch: v = vmax if load<=4 else 0 if load>=7 else vmax*(7-load)/3; if load>=8.5: sref -= 0.004

skills.name: no_servo_windup
skills.failure_signature: tool blocked against a peg (tool centre 0.045 m from peg centre) while the commanded point runs ahead (lag 0.03-0.17 m); on release it races at 0.7-1.9 m/s and the load spikes to 11-21 N (observation 900, 906, 908)
skills.repair_strategy: Command a point ON the path that advances only while the tool is within 2 cm of it; keep the path >= 0.065 m from peg centres (0.02 m gap beyond tool+peg radii).
skills.code_sketch: if norm(tool - P(sref)) < 0.02: sref += v*dt; cmd = P(sref)

skills.name: soft_arrival
skills.failure_signature: tool overshoots or is still moving at the target (rest rule |v|<=0.02 m/s within 0.02 m)
skills.repair_strategy: Ramp v down proportional to remaining arc length (floor 0.012 m/s) and end the reference exactly at the target; success fires on entry to the 2 cm ball at low speed.

skills.name: stall_recovery_and_clock
skills.failure_signature: reference not advancing for many steps (load held between 7 and 8.5 N, or tool blocked) -> time-out
skills.repair_strategy: After 20 steps without progress, back the reference off 2 cm along the path; after t=400 raise load thresholds by 1 N (back-off by 0.5 N) to finish within 600 steps.
validated_by: flown in life_4, life_5 and eval without being triggered (replay of lives 2-3 gives identical commands to v2)
